title: Inscribed Rectangle Conjecture - State the Puzzle
full_prompt: Write a Manim script using ManimGL (or standard Manim CE with appropriate adaptations) that visualizes the 'Inscribed Rectangle Problem' (Toeplitz's conjecture). The scene should define a smooth, closed loop (either loaded from an SVG or defined parametrically) and place four distinct, colored dots on it. Connect these dots with dynamic lines to form an inscribed quadrilateral. Implement a numerical solver (like the `find_rectangle` function in the reference) that searches the parameter space of the loop to find four points that form a perfect rectangle (where the diagonals are equal in length, share the same midpoint, and are perpendicular/at a target angle). Animate the dots moving smoothly along the loop from an arbitrary initial configuration to the solved rectangular configuration, highlighting the final rectangle with a distinct color or glow effect.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing SVG file 'example_loop1' causing runtime crash
common_failure_modes.note: If the SVG is missing, the code should fallback to a parametric curve (like a deformed ellipse) to ensure executability.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Infinite loop or slow performance in find_rectangle optimization
common_failure_modes.note: Keep the number of refinements and samples low to avoid freezing the animation generation.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Updater functions referencing stale ValueTracker states
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure updaters correctly read the current value of the tracker on every frame.
